original_frontmatter.name: antialgorithm
original_frontmatter.description: Stops the safe, average, comfortable pick that AI reaches for first. Use when a creative choice is left open to the agent: ideas, names, story, game mechanics, visual style, color, poster or page layout, app or web interface design, composition, slogans, titles, taglines, creative copy. Not for code identifiers, bug fixes, choices the user already made, or texts whose form the user's standing rules already set, such as a README, a store page, a commit message, release notes or license text. Also use when the user says "too generic", "boring", "typical AI", "too safe", "cliche", "average", "seen it before".
